subject: 🐋 Not sure what to say to Orca?
preview: Three ways people start. Pick the one that fits today.
h1_bold: Here are three ways people start.

blocks.alt: Illustration: an orca tail rising over waves in front of a coral sun

blocks.text: Open Before therapy the day before your session. You get a one-page card with a short summary of what came up since last time and up to three numbered questions to bring.
Write down what stuck with you while it's fresh, so it doesn't fade by Tuesday. Your After therapy card keeps it for next time.
Talk it through with Orca in Reflect instead of scrolling. A few lines are enough, and you can stop whenever you want.
All three work on the free version of MindSync, so you can start today.
This is our last nudge about getting started. If MindSync isn't for you right now, no hard feelings, and your account will be here if you change your mind.

footer_promise: We promise to only send you mental health-related tips & updates.

footer_image.alt: Illustration: a lighthouse on a cliff, a sailboat and a coral sun

crisis_line: MindSync isn't a crisis service. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US, or find a local helpline at findahelpline.com.

sources.item: Before therapy, After therapy and Reflect messages are available on Free (with monthly limits)
Reflect voice mode is Premium only, so P2b no longer says 'out loud'
